# ReviewReply AI

> AI-powered Google Business Profile review management platform that automates review replies, tracks sentiment, and helps businesses grow their online reputation.

## About

ReviewReply AI is a review management platform built specifically for Google Business Profile. It centralizes the entire review lifecycle — collecting reviews, generating AI-powered replies, tracking sentiment, and reporting on reputation growth — inside one modern dashboard.

Businesses that receive a high volume of Google reviews often struggle to reply consistently, miss negative reviews that need urgent attention, and waste hours writing responses manually. ReviewReply AI solves this by connecting directly to a business's Google Business Profile, automatically syncing all reviews, and using AI to generate context-aware, brand-aligned replies in seconds — while also giving businesses sentiment analysis and reputation analytics to track performance over time.

Setup takes under 2 minutes: connect the Google Business Profile, reviews sync automatically, and the AI starts generating ready-to-publish replies.

## Core Features

- AI Review Replies — context-aware, brand-aligned responses generated instantly for Google reviews
- Google Review Sync — automatically imports all reviews from a connected Google Business Profile, no manual entry
- Sentiment Analysis — AI-powered classification of reviews as positive, neutral, or negative
- Review Dashboard — unified view of all reviews across multiple business locations
- Low Rating Alerts — instant notifications when a negative review needs urgent attention
- Response Tracking — monitors reply rates and response times
- Smart Analytics — dashboards for tracking sentiment, ratings, and reputation trends
- Review Tags & Search — organize and filter reviews using custom tags
- CSV & PDF Export — export review data and reports for stakeholders and audits
- Monthly Reports — automated reports tracking reputation growth over time
- Email Notifications — real-time alerts delivered to the inbox for new reviews
- QR Code Generator — shareable QR codes to help businesses collect more reviews
- Team Members — collaborate with a team and assign review management roles
- Priority Support — dedicated support for reputation management

## How It Works

1. Connect Profile — link the Google Business Profile in under 2 minutes
2. Sync Reviews — all reviews import automatically from Google
3. AI Generates Replies — personalized, professional responses ready to publish
4. Monitor & Analyze — track sentiment, ratings, and engagement in real time
5. Grow Reputation — build customer trust and improve local search visibility

- Agencies & Professionals — marketing agencies and consultants managing reviews for multiple clients
- Any business, single-location or multi-location enterprise, with a Google Business Profile

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What does ReviewReply AI do?**
It automatically generates AI-powered replies to Google Business Profile reviews and provides sentiment analysis and reputation analytics.

**Does it work with Google Business Profile?**
Yes, it connects directly to Google Business Profile and automatically syncs all reviews.

**Can it handle multiple business locations?**
Yes, it supports multi-location and multi-branch review management from a single dashboard.

**Does it flag negative reviews?**
Yes, low rating alerts instantly notify the business when a negative review needs attention.

**Who is ReviewReply AI built for?**
Small businesses, restaurants, healthcare providers, retail and service businesses, and marketing agencies managing reviews for multiple clients.
